description: This file defines the StringHelper class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared namespace. The class provides various static utility methods for string manipulation, encoding conversions, character set handling, and locale-based number formatting, specifically tailored for spreadsheet processing.

classes.name: StringHelper
classes.description: A helper class offering static methods for string processing, encoding, locale-aware formatting, and conversion tasks relevant to spreadsheet data handling.

methods.name: buildControlCharacters
methods.description: Builds the array of control characters used in string conversions.

methods.name: buildSYLKCharacters
methods.description: Constructs the array mapping SYLK encoded strings to Unicode characters.

methods.name: getIsIconvEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the iconv extension is available and functioning.

methods.name: buildCharacterSets
methods.description: Initializes character sets by building control characters and SYLK character mappings.

methods.name: controlCharacterOOXML2PHP
methods.description: Converts escaped control characters in OOXML to PHP control characters.

methods.name: controlCharacterPHP2OOXML
methods.description: Encodes PHP control characters into OOXML escape sequences.

methods.name: sanitizeUTF8
methods.description: Sanitizes a UTF-8 string by replacing invalid sequences with the Unicode replacement character.

methods.name: returnString
methods.description: Ensures the input is returned as a string.

methods.name: isUTF8
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number as a string, ensuring decimal separator consistency.

methods.name: UTF8toBIFF8UnicodeShort
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 strings to BIFF8 Unicode format with uncompressed notation, supporting rich text runs.

methods.name: UTF8toBIFF8UnicodeLong
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 strings to BIFF8 Unicode format with 16-bit length prefix.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding between specified formats, using iconv if available.

methods.name: countCharacters
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in a string, using mb_strlen.

methods.name: countCharactersDbcs
methods.description: Returns character width of a string, using mb_strwidth.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: strToUpper
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to uppercase.

methods.name: strToLower
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to lowercase.

methods.name: strToTitle
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to title case.

methods.name: mbIsUpper
methods.description: Checks if a character is uppercase.

methods.name: mbStrSplit
methods.description: Splits a UTF-8 string into an array of characters.

methods.name: strCaseReverse
methods.description: Reverses the case of each character in a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: getDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-based decimal separator, defaulting to '.' if unavailable.

methods.name: setDecimalSeparator
methods.description: Sets the decimal separator character.

methods.name: getThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-based thousands separator, defaulting to ',' if unavailable.

methods.name: setThousandsSeparator
methods.description: Sets the thousands separator character.

methods.name: getCurrencyCode
methods.description: Retrieves the currency code based on locale, defaulting to '$'.

methods.name: setCurrencyCode
methods.description: Sets the currency code.

methods.name: SYLKtoUTF8
methods.description: Converts a SYLK encoded string to UTF-8.

methods.name: testStringAsNumeric
methods.description: Returns the leading numeric part of a string or the string itself if not numeric.
